outline: 簡介作業研究Systems Analysis中的各式優選工具，並學習混沌理論。以生態族群的Growth and Decay模式為例，初窺混沌世界的奇妙，以提供往後解決問題時有不同的思考方向。混沌理論應用在物理、經濟、生物、數學的領域上，處理數百年來許多無法看透的問題有不錯進展(包括紊流現象)，在環境領域上的應用則尚待開拓。只要處理的系統(問題)具有自我相似性，以混沌來處理是可行的。(課程中將視時間教進階數學軟體Mathematica.)  Explore Chaos Theory from the Models of Growth and Decay (Simple Logistic Model, Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity, Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity and Migration).  Introduce important factors of Chaotic Behavior: Dynamics of species, Critical Reproduction Rate, Bifurcation, Butterfly effect.  Examples of Chaotic behavior: Single Species System, Two Species Competition System, Two Species Predator-Prey System. Mathematica Software (optional).
schedule:
1. 優選工具簡介
	線性規劃
	時間序列、啟發式演算法、類神經網路、灰色理論/模糊理論
	賽局理論、小世界理論
2. Models of Growth and Decay
	Simple Logistic Model
	Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity
	Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity and Migration
3. Chaotic 混沌Behavior (week 3交HW1)
	Dynamics of species
	Critical Reproduction Rate
	Bifurcation
4. Examples of Chaotic behavior
	Single Species System
	Two Species Competition System
	Two Species Predator-Prey System
5. Butterfly effect蝴蝶效應. Deterministic or Random? (week 5交HW2)
6. Final Exam; 進階數學軟體Mathematica
assessment: 學期成績計算方式： 2 HW + 1 Exam: 2*33%+33%
